import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
a = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = a[...,0],a[...,1],a[...,2]
H,W = R.shape
# downsample to 64x48 classes
def cls(r,g,b):
    if r>140 and r-g>25 and r-b>20: return 'P'  # pink
    if b>110 and b-r>45: return 'B' # strong blue
    if b>90 and b-r>25: return 'b'
    if r>180 and g>180 and b>180: return '#' # white/light
    if r<70 and g<70 and b<70: return '.' # dark
    if abs(r-g)<18 and abs(g-b)<18: return 'o' # gray
    return '?'
gh,gw=48,64
for gy in range(gh):
    row=''
    for gx in range(gw):
        y0,y1=gy*H//gh,(gy+1)*H//gh
        x0,x1=gx*W//gw,(gx+1)*W//gw
        block=np.stack([R[y0:y1,x0:x1],G[y0:y1,x0:x1],B[y0:y1,x0:x1]]).reshape(3,-1)
        r,g,b=block.mean(axis=1)
        row+=cls(r,g,b)
    print(row)
\""
